**Handoff is at [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).**

Root cause is `dep-4471`, which set `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true` at 02:13:41Z. The pool stayed size 20 and saturated. Impact ran 02:14:18Z to end of log, 1h 45m, 530 of 636 requests failed. Roll back `dep-4471` or revert config generation 119 to 118.

The doc also flags two things for you. This log is node-3 only, so check nodes 1 and 2. And worker job runtime creeps hourly for an unrelated reason.
